key_note: Rocky v2.0.1 improves the pet’s autonomy, daily rhythm, and assistant experience with smarter sleep behavior, proactive routines, and major Control Center refinements.
whats_new: Refined the Control Center UI/UX and added AutoSave support
Implemented adaptive sleep cycles synced with the master’s schedule
Increased default sleep duration for more natural proactive behavior
Added Daily Digest and Day Wrap-Up behaviors
Implemented Intelligent Idle Mode to detect inactivity/busy states and sleep automatically
Improved overall assistant autonomy, realism, and system stability
